site_program: Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Wardha
screening_population: all hospital-born neonates in postnatal ward or NICU; prenatal duct-dependent CHD excluded
screening_timing_raw: starting 4 h after birth; repeated day 2 and day 3; 90-95% rechecked after 6 h oxygenation
screening_algorithm_raw: <90% or >3% limb difference immediate positive; 90-95% re-evaluated after 6 h; all hypoxemic/suspect infants underwent echo
final_failed_screens: not point-identifiable; source reports 164 hypoxemic/echo-evaluated but includes infants who normalized on repeat
study_target_definition_raw: critical/major CHD requiring neonatal intervention, inconsistently reported
diagnosis_counts_raw: critical/major CHD; noncritical CHD; echo-negative alternative diagnoses; normal
diagnostic_category_exclusivity: 164 hypoxemic/echo-evaluated; text says CHD44=major12+minor32, but Table1 says noncritical34+critical12=46; 144 had 90-95%, 78 remained hypoxemic after 6 h and 66 normalized; among reported false positives: severe birth asphyxia9, meconium aspiration14, sepsis67, PPHN16, pneumothorax2, normal12 (sum120)
lesion_mapping_status: major table: pulmonary atresia/stenosis5; TGA2; TAPVR3; TGA+VSD1; functional univentricular heart1; noncritical table includes ASD/VSD/PDA/VSD+PDA
management_actionability_evidence: No harmonized participant denominator can be constructed because the 164 source positives include repeat-normalized infants and cardiac counts conflict internally. Lesion-level remapping cannot repair the missing final-fail flow.
ascertained_cchd_negative_failed_screens: Alternative diagnoses are clinically important, but they are reported across the source false-positive/echo-negative group rather than a reconstructable final-failed-screen cohort. Mixed NICU/postnatal setting independently precludes principal pooling.
source_full_text_provenance: final failed-screen analytic denominator cannot be recovered; source cardiac arithmetic is internally inconsistent; mixed NICU/postnatal cohort inseparable
extraction_notes: Jain D, Jain M, Lamture Y. Cureus. 2022;14:e32852. PMID 36699784; PMCID PMC9870300; DOI 10.7759/cureus.32852. Open-access full text independently reverified.
qa_status: The 164 hypoxemic/echo-evaluated infants cannot be treated as final fails because 66 of 144 borderline 90-95% infants normalized after the protocol-defined repeat. The source also conflicts between CHD44 in narrative and 46 in Table1. Preserve rich alternative-diagnosis data descriptively only; no CAN-CCHD effect estimate is created.

site_program: four Yogyakarta hospitals including Dr Sardjito/JIH/Sadewa/Sakina Idaman
screening_population: seemingly healthy newborns; <35 weeks, prenatal CHD, dysmorphism, cyanosis, murmur or abnormal vital signs excluded
screening_timing_raw: study intended 24-48 h; actual 59% screened <=24 h and 41% >24 h
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal AAP-style algorithm: <90 immediate fail; 90-94 or >3% difference persistent over three measurements -> fail/echo
study_target_definition_raw: source calls 8/10 CCHD using a broad severe/first-year-intervention concept
diagnosis_counts_raw: source CCHD8; small secundum ASD1; PFO1
individual_diagnoses: Ebstein x2; PA+VSD+vertical PDA x1; tricuspid atresia+PA+small ASD x1; mitral atresia+TGA+severe PS+single ventricle+hypoplastic LV x1; tricuspid atresia+inlet VSD+ASD+small RV+PS x1; DORV+TGA+VSD x1; unbalanced AVSD+moderate PDA x1; small secundum ASD x1; PFO x1
lesion_mapping_status: No source-defined CCHD case is an unconditional harmonized lesion as reported. PA+VSD is conditional without <=28-day event; PA in the tricuspid-atresia complex is not explicitly PA/IVS; TGA occurs only in complex anatomy and is not simple TGA; PS is conditional without <=28-day event; Ebstein/tricuspid atresia/DORV/unbalanced AVSD are not automatic target lesions. Harmonized CCHD=0.
management_actionability_evidence: All eight severe structural diagnoses are clinically relevant but the primary report does not provide participant-specific treatment/escalation/disposition or required follow-up beyond referral for diagnostic echocardiography; diagnostic referral alone is insufficient for Strict -> CAN-U8. Small ASD and PFO have no qualifying consequence -> NON_CAN2.
poolability_reason: point-identifiable final-fail denominator, complete participant-level diagnostic classification, healthy-appearing screening population and 100% ascertainment; early timing retained as heterogeneity flag
source_full_text_provenance: Murni IK et al. BMC Pediatr. 2022;22:369. PMID 35761296; PMCID PMC9235153; DOI 10.1186/s12887-022-03404-0. Open-access primary full text independently reverified.
extraction_notes: Strict0/10; Expanded8/10; NON_CAN2. The source's 8/10 CCHD label is not accepted as the harmonized target. Source flow states 7 first-screen positives plus 5 requiring repeat, of whom 2 passed and 3 remained positive, yielding 10 referred final positives.

site_program: planned out-of-hospital births, largely Amish/Mennonite Plain communities
screening_population: out-of-hospital newborn cohort with early and late midwife screening
screening_algorithm_raw: combined early+late screening analyzed under both strict algorithm interpretation and midwife field interpretation because they did not always agree
final_failed_screens: 34 field-positive / 37 algorithm-positive reconstructed from reported TP/sensitivity/PPV; convention-dependent
study_target_definition_raw: source detected 3 CCHD but lesion identities not recovered in accessible primary text
cchd_negative_final_failed_screen_denomi: source-defined CCHD-negative: approximately 31 field / 35 algorithm; harmonized denominator unresolved
unknown_unascertained_n: approximately 19-23 not clinically characterized by accessible report
diagnosis_categories_raw: noncritical CHD; pulmonary disease; infection; other/uncharacterized false positives
diagnosis_counts_raw: 12 false-positive cases had other pathology; remaining false-positive cases not clinically characterized in accessible primary text
individual_diagnoses: noncritical CHD / pulmonary issues / infection; individual lesion identities not recovered
lesion_mapping_status: The three source-CCHD cases cannot be harmonized lesion-by-lesion from the accessible primary text. Reported combined-screen sensitivity/PPV imply different field vs strict-algorithm positive counts, so a single canonical denominator cannot be selected without violating the source design.
management_actionability_evidence: The 12 alternative-pathology cases have diagnosis evidence but no sufficiently linked treatment/escalation/disposition consequence in the accessible primary record -> CAN-U lower bound12. Strict remains 0 on recovered linked evidence.
poolability_reason: field versus algorithm denominator differs; CCHD lesions are not available for harmonized target mapping; only 12 false-positive cases have alternative pathology characterized
source_full_text_provenance: Williams KB et al. Pediatrics. 2021;148(4):e2020048785. PMID 34531289; DOI 10.1542/peds.2020-048785. Primary abstract/full-record metadata reverified; article PDF access was blocked by publisher anti-bot validation in this pass.
extraction_notes: Reported combined-screen sensitivity 100% with PPV8.8% under field interpretation is consistent with 3 TP/34 positives ->31 FP; algorithm sensitivity66.7% with PPV5.4% is consistent with 2 TP/37 positives ->35 FP. These reconstructed counts remain sensitivity-only, not a harmonized point denominator. Expanded lower-bound proportion is 12/31 to 12/35 depending convention.

site_program: Pulse Oximetry Leiden Screening (POLS), Leiden region
screening_population: home births plus very early post-delivery hospital discharge; community midwife/hospital screening
screening_timing_raw: median first 1.8 h; second 37 h on day 2-3
screening_algorithm_raw: adapted pre/postductal protocol; positive screening referred for pediatric assessment
study_target_definition_raw: CCHD screening; no CCHD detected in pilot cohort
diagnosis_categories_raw: respiratory pathology; infection/sepsis; noncritical CHD; other pathology; healthy
diagnosis_counts_raw: later same-investigator program summary: respiratory8 + infection/sepsis3 + noncritical CHD3 + other pathology2 + healthy16 =32; primary article states important pathology in 62% of 32 (~20), creating numerator discrepancy
individual_diagnoses: respiratory pathology8; infection/sepsis3; noncritical CHD3; other pathology2; healthy16 in later same-program summary
lesion_mapping_status: No CCHD occurred, so harmonized denominator=32. The primary 62% important-pathology statement conflicts with the later same-investigator 16/32 pathology table; no forced reconciliation is made.
management_actionability_evidence: Primary report documents referral and important pathology detection but does not link specific treatment/escalation/disposition consequences sufficiently for Strict coding. Thus Strict0 on recovered evidence; clinically relevant diagnosis burden is bounded as CAN-U16-20 pending the unresolved source-summary discrepancy.
poolability_reason: denominator and ascertainment are complete, but clinically relevant numerator is internally discrepant across primary abstract versus later same-investigator summary; exact Expanded effect is therefore bounded
source_full_text_provenance: Narayen IC et al. J Pediatr. 2016;170:188-192.e1. PMID 26746119; DOI 10.1016/j.jpeds.2015.12.004. Primary abstract/results reverified; later Narayen/te Pas Dutch-experience report used only to expose category distribution and discrepancy.
extraction_notes: Strict0/32 on linked primary management evidence. Expanded is preserved as 16-20/32: later same-program table gives 16 pathology +16 healthy, while primary article states 62% important pathology (~20/32). Pilot Oct2013-Oct2014 and POLAR Jul2015-Dec2016 are temporally non-overlapping but share DUTCH_POLS_POLAR cluster.
